headlines.title_en: SAFE Administrator Zhu Hexin meets with Hong Kong SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong and CEO Julia Leung
headlines.summary_en: On September 11, 2026, Zhu Hexin, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China and Administrator of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, met with visiting Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission Chairman Tim Lui and Chief Executive Officer Julia Leung. SAFE Deputy Administrator Li Bin attended the meeting. (SAFE website)

headlines.summary_zh: 中国8月份工厂出厂价格增速加快，而消费者通胀再次抬头，原因在于与美以对伊朗战争相关的能源和大宗商品成本波动。国家统计局周三发布的数据显示，上月生产者价格指数同比上涨3.8%，高于7月份的3.5%。

headlines.summary: 9月10日，中国商务部研究院国际服务贸易研究所在服贸会上发布《入境游促进消费的内在机理及增长潜力研究》，该报告在携程集团支持下完成，报告尤其关注中国入境游发展现状与特点。报告称，中国入境游已形成较好基础，有望迈入高质量发展新阶段，预计未来10年中国入境旅游收入占GDP比重有望提升至国际平均水平，这意味着约1万亿至3万亿元人民币的潜在市场增量。（环球时报）

headlines.title_en: Research report forecasts: China's inbound tourism may see a 3 trillion yuan market increment over the next 10 years
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, the Institute of International Trade in Services at the Chinese Academy of International Trade and Economic Cooperation under the Ministry of Commerce released the "Research on the Intrinsic Mechanisms and Growth Potential of Inbound Tourism in Promoting Consumption" at the China International Fair for Trade in Services. The report, completed with support from Trip.com Group, focuses in particular on the current state and characteristics of China's inbound tourism development. The report states that China's inbound tourism has formed a solid foundation and is expected to enter a new stage of high-quality development. It is projected that in the next 10 years, the share of China's inbound tourism revenue in GDP is expected to rise to the international average level, implying a potential market increment of approximately 1 trillion to 3 trillion yuan. (Global Times)

headlines.title: 厄尔尼诺扰动供给，农产品期货价格升温
headlines.summary: 受厄尔尼诺影响，全球部分产区极端天气风险上升，部分农产品供给预期因此受到扰动。近期，从种植、种业到化肥、农药，A股农业产业链热度持续攀升，多种农产品期货价格走强。世界气象组织日前预计，本轮厄尔尼诺将在未来数月进一步增强。机构人士认为，天气扰动可能影响部分农产品供给，并向农资需求、替代品消费等环节传导。不过，各产区、各品种所受影响存在差异，行情能否延续，仍需观察减产预期与实际供需的变化。（中国证券报）

headlines.title_en: El Nino disrupts supply, agricultural futures prices heat up
headlines.summary_en: Affected by El Nino, the risk of extreme weather has risen in some global production areas, disrupting supply expectations for some agricultural products. Recently, from planting and seed breeding to fertilizers and pesticides, the A-share agricultural industry chain has seen continuously rising interest, with futures prices for multiple agricultural products strengthening. The World Meteorological Organization recently forecast that this round of El Nino will further intensify in the coming months. Institutional analysts believe that weather disruptions may affect the supply of some agricultural products and transmit through to agricultural input demand, substitute consumption and other links. However, the impact varies across production areas and crop varieties, and whether the rally can continue still requires observation of changes in production-reduction expectations and actual supply and demand. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 多只宽基ETF成交放量，市场调整中资金借道积极入市
headlines.summary: 9月11日，多只宽基ETF成交显著放量。过去一周（9月4日至9月10日），股票型ETF资金净流入超过百亿元，其中，宽基ETF成为“吸金”主力。站在当前时点，多位绩优基金经理表示，看好权益资产长期表现。展望后市，机构普遍持乐观态度。融通基金基金经理李进表示，在近期调整之后，现阶段市场整体估值相对较低，对后市持审慎乐观态度。其中，制造业红利叠加品牌力，成本比海外对手低，加上产品迭代速度、研发周期有极强优势，让一批出海标的公司显现出了足够韧性，海外市场份额不断提升。（上海证券报）

headlines.title_en: Multiple broad-based ETFs see trading volume surge, funds actively enter the market amid market adjustment
headlines.summary_en: On September 11, trading volume in multiple broad-based ETFs increased significantly. Over the past week (September 4 to September 10), net inflows into equity ETFs exceeded 10 billion yuan, with broad-based ETFs being the main force attracting capital. At the current juncture, several fund managers with strong performance expressed optimism about the long-term performance of equity assets. Looking ahead, institutions are generally optimistic. Li Jin, fund manager at Rongtong Fund, said that after the recent correction, overall market valuations are relatively low at present, and he holds a cautiously optimistic view on the outlook. Among them, the combination of manufacturing advantages and brand strength, lower costs compared with overseas competitors, and strong advantages in product iteration speed and R&D cycles have allowed a group of companies with overseas expansion to demonstrate sufficient resilience, with their overseas market share continuously rising. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title_en: Shanghai (Yangtze River Delta) International Science and Technology Innovation Center releases phased achievements
headlines.summary_en: The opening ceremony of the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum was held on September 12, where the phased achievements of building Shanghai (Yangtze River Delta) as an international center for science and technology innovation were released in video form. It was mentioned that Shanghai plays a leading and driving role, while Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Anhui each leverage their respective strengths. The three provinces and one municipality share resources, jointly build platforms, jointly cultivate ecosystems and jointly promote reform. Their capacity for scientific and technological innovation sourcing, high-end industry leadership and top talent aggregation is accelerating. The construction of the international center for science and technology innovation has moved from a single-city breakthrough to a new stage of coordinated and integrated development across the Yangtze River Delta region. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 美联储9月加息概率超88%
headlines.summary: 【美联储9月加息概率超88%】当地时间9月11日，美国劳工统计局公布的数据显示，8月消费者价格指数（CPI）同比上涨3.4%，剔除食品和能源价格的8月核心CPI同比上涨2.4%，两份数据均符合市场预期。由于8月CPI数据没有表明美国通胀压力显著缓解，市场押注美联储下周议息会议加息25个基点的概率迅速攀升至超过88%。

headlines.title_en: Probability of a Fed rate hike in September exceeds 88%
headlines.summary_en: [Fed September rate hike probability exceeds 88%] On September 11 local time, data released by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics showed that the August Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 3.4% year-on-year, and the August core CPI, excluding food and energy prices, rose 2.4% year-on-year. Both readings were in line with market expectations. As the August CPI data did not indicate a significant easing of U.S. inflation pressure, market bets on the Fed raising rates by 25 basis points at next week's policy meeting quickly climbed to over 88%.

headlines.title: 国家超算互联网用户突破170万
headlines.summary: 中科曙光副总裁曹振南在2026中国算力大会主论坛上披露，国家超算互联网注册用户量已突破170万，累计完成作业量突破2.7亿个，国产算力占比超95%。曹振南介绍，国家超算互联网平台已汇聚CPU核心超350万、GPU卡超25万，日均作业数突破30万个，峰值突破100万个。平台应用商城入驻商户超880家，下单量超24万，覆盖科研创新、人工智能、工业仿真等领域。（界面）

headlines.title_en: National Supercomputing Internet users exceed 1.7 million
headlines.summary_en: Cao Zhennan, Vice President of Sugon, disclosed at the main forum of the 2026 China Computing Power Conference that the National Supercomputing Internet has surpassed 1.7 million registered users, with cumulative completed jobs exceeding 270 million, and domestic computing power accounting for over 95%. Cao Zhennan introduced that the National Supercomputing Internet platform has aggregated over 3.5 million CPU cores and over 250,000 GPU cards, with daily average jobs exceeding 300,000 and peak exceeding 1 million. The platform's application marketplace has over 880 merchants, with over 240,000 orders, covering scientific research and innovation, artificial intelligence, industrial simulation and other fields. (Jiemian)

headlines.title: 南向资金7月以来净买入近千亿港元，科技与红利资产获显著加仓
headlines.summary: 2026年下半年以来，恒生科技指数领跑全球股市，与此同时，南向资金持续加码港股市场。数据显示，截至9月11日，南向资金7月以来合计净买入近千亿港元，其中，科技龙头与红利资产成为资金追捧的焦点。多家机构认为，从估值水平来看，港股性价比依然突出，在当前较为震荡的市场环境中，科技和红利两类资产具有显著的配置价值。（上海证券报）

headlines.title_en: Southbound capital net buying reaches nearly HK$100 billion since July, with notable additions to technology and dividend assets
headlines.summary_en: Since the second half of 2026, the Hang Seng Tech Index has led global stock markets, while southbound capital has continued to increase its allocation to the Hong Kong stock market. Data shows that as of September 11, southbound capital had recorded total net buying of nearly HK$100 billion since July, with technology leaders and dividend assets becoming the focus of capital pursuit. Multiple institutions believe that from a valuation perspective, Hong Kong stocks remain highly cost-effective, and in the current relatively volatile market environment, technology and dividend assets have significant allocation value. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 京津冀四地携手发布共建太空算力产业长廊倡议
headlines.summary: 在2026中国算力大会上，北京经济技术开发区、天津经济技术开发区、河北雄安新区、廊坊市四地携手，发起共建京津冀太空算力产业长廊倡议：一是深化战略协同，争做下一代AI基础设施建设引领者。二是聚力研发创新，夯实技术根基。三是强化示范应用，拓展赋能边界。四是激发集群效应，建设产业高地。五是促进政策同频，护航企业成长。六是倡导开放合作，探索中国方案。（人民邮电报）

headlines.title_en: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei four regions jointly release initiative to build a space computing power industry corridor
headlines.summary_en: At the 2026 China Computing Power Conference, Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area, Tianjin Economic-Technological Development Area, Hebei Xiong'an New Area and Langfang City joined hands to launch an initiative to jointly build the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Space Computing Power Industry Corridor: First, deepen strategic coordination and strive to be leaders in next-generation AI infrastructure construction. Second, focus on R&D and innovation to consolidate the technological foundation. Third, strengthen demonstration applications and expand the boundaries of empowerment. Fourth, stimulate cluster effects and build an industrial highland. Fifth, promote policy alignment to safeguard enterprise growth. Sixth, advocate open cooperation and explore Chinese solutions. (People's Posts and Telecommunications News)

headlines.title: 全国算力“一张网、一盘棋、一体化”发展格局基本形成
headlines.summary: 从河北廊坊举办的2026中国算力大会了解到，中国算力平台实现全国算力一体化统筹监测，我国算力“一张网、一盘棋、一体化”发展格局基本形成。当前，算力基础设施已成为驱动人工智能发展的关键底座、经济社会高质量发展的重要引擎。工业和信息化部近日印发《信息通信行业发展“十五五”规划》，明确提出加快全国一体化算力网建设，构建“枢纽—区域—边缘”多层次算力设施体系，深化算力自动化监测与供需匹配。（央视）

headlines.title_en: National computing power "one network, one chessboard, integrated development" framework basically formed
headlines.summary_en: It was learned from the 2026 China Computing Power Conference held in Langfang, Hebei, that China's computing power platform has achieved nationwide integrated monitoring of computing power, and the development pattern of "one network, one chessboard, integrated development" for China's computing power has basically taken shape. Currently, computing power infrastructure has become a key foundation driving artificial intelligence development and an important engine for high-quality economic and social development. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology recently issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communications Industry," explicitly proposing to accelerate the construction of a nationwide integrated computing power network, build a multi-level computing power facility system of "hub-region-edge," and deepen automated monitoring of computing power and supply-demand matching. (CCTV)

headlines.title: 工业和信息化部总工程师钟志红：加快算力标准体系建设指南编制
headlines.summary: 工业和信息化部总工程师钟志红在2026中国算力大会上表示，算力已成为数据时代不可或缺的新型信息基础设施。“十五五”规划纲要明确提出，构建多层次算力设施体系和全国一体化算力网。

headlines.title_en: MIIT Chief Engineer Zhong Zhihong: Accelerate the drafting of guidelines for building the computing power standards system
headlines.summary_en: Zhong Zhihong, Chief Engineer of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, said at the 2026 China Computing Power Conference that computing power has become an indispensable new type of information infrastructure in the data era. The outline of the 15th Five-Year Plan explicitly proposes building a multi-level computing power facility system and a nationwide integrated computing power network.
